conversion: GRIB one-hour tp kg/m2 -> mm accumulation -> numeric mm/h mean rate
limitations: Radar/gauge estimated analysis, not direct rainfall measurements at every cell.
Native bitmap preserved; no zero fill, fitted rescaling or forecast substitution.
Archive publication latency/quality revision can differ from GRIB reference time.
interpretation: 46 requested hourly analysis files are retained. Native bitmap masks the full domain during November 1 12:00-13:00 UTC; this interval remains missing. Later valid analysis is retained. Separate 14:00-17:00 HRRR transition is forecast, not observation. No automatic stitching or zero fill.
